title: Notification Deliveries
targetMaskedHint: The ledger only stores masked targets; use this shape to locate a recipient
attemptsHint: Including the first. Sync delivery is always 1; async delivery increments before each dial. So "Sending + 0" is still queued, "Sending + 1 or more" dialed without settling
requestIdHint: Shared by all deliveries produced by one business call; generated server-side when the caller omits it
relatedIdHint: Meaning depends on the event: in-app message = message ID
